approval_ref: Continue improving CIRP efficiency, accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and Email content, with file-grounded project questions modeled on Trunk Tools.
notes: Reproduce an answered Email subject that is absent from an otherwise exact citation.
Keep each explicit Subject, Email subject or Subject line claim equal to one complete cited Subject header.
Reject cross-Email borrowing and a subject recombined from two cited headers.
Do not treat an RFI or Submittal form's Subject field as an Email subject.
Require an explicit subject value when an answered question asks for one, including comparisons.
Accept formatting-only case, repeated whitespace, outer quotation and answer-ending punctuation outside the subject value while preserving punctuation quoted inside the subject.
Use synthetic evidence and make no provider request.
title: Ground Email subject claims
objective: Prevent an Email subject answer from being invented, recombined, omitted or borrowed across source findings while retaining exact readable subject output.
